Six ways to use one room.

The room never changes. What we put in it does. Pick the night you're planning and we'll set the room up for it before you arrive — you walk in, and it's already done.

Ask us anything Leave your number and we'll call you back.

  1. 01

    Date Night

    Just the two of you, a screen that's all yours, and nobody waiting on your table. No queue for the good seats, no stranger's phone lighting up two rows ahead, and no one asking you to settle the bill while the film is still running.

    Best for
    2 guests
    Runtime
    2h 30m
    Set-up
    Low light, table for two
    From
    ₹1,499

  2. 02

    Watch Party

    Your match, your show, your people — at a volume you'd never get away with at home. Bring the group, put the game on the big screen, and shout at it as loudly as it deserves.

    Best for
    4–8 guests
    Runtime
    2h 30m
    Set-up
    Big screen, full sound
    From
    ₹1,499

  3. 03

    Karaoke

    Your playlist, your voices, no queue and absolutely no judging. The room is closed, so the only people who hear the high note you didn't reach are the ones who came with you.

    Best for
    4–10 guests
    Runtime
    2h 30m
    Set-up
    Mic, lyrics on screen
    From
    ₹1,499

  4. 04

    Proposal

    Set the scene exactly how you pictured it, then ask the question. Tell us the moment you want — the song, the slide, the cue to dim the lights — and we'll have it ready and stay out of the way.

    Best for
    2 guests
    Runtime
    2h 30m
    Set-up
    Decor, your cue, our timing
    From
    ₹1,499

  5. 05

    Candlelight Dinner

    A table laid for two, warm light, and an empty room around you. Good for an anniversary, a birthday, or a Tuesday that needed rescuing.

    Best for
    2 guests
    Runtime
    2h 30m
    Set-up
    Candles, table, quiet
    From
    ₹1,499

  6. 06

    Stand-Up Night

    Pull up the specials, bring the snacks, and laugh as loud as you like. Or put someone from your own group on the floor and find out how they do.

    Best for

    Runtime

    From
